source_text: Ordo amoris in Libro III: a communione cubilis ad laudem florum, ab umbra mali ad cellam caritatis, a somno custodiae ad vocem salientem, a claustris hiemalibus ad ostensionem faciei in petra, a flore vineae ad captionem vulpium. Gradus proficientis hic clauduntur.
pass_a_gloss: Order of-love in Book III: from communion of-couch to praise of-flowers, from shadow of-apple to cellar of-charity, from sleep of-watching to voice leaping, from enclosures wintry to showing of-face in rock, from flower of-vineyard to catching of-foxes. Steps of-one-progressing here are-closed.
pass_b_english: The order of love in Book III: from sharing the couch to praise of the flowers, from the apple’s shadow to the cellar of charity, from guarded sleep to the leaping voice, from winter enclosures to showing the face in the rock, from the vineyard’s flower to catching the foxes. Here the steps of the one who progresses are closed.
